story.alert: 01:05 · TARGETING VOLT'S GUARD POST · CITADEL CORE
story.vex: Even the shield guard leaves a door open. Especially the shield guard. (Commander Vex, Planet Doom)
story.victory: DOOM ATTACK REPELLED. Volt's own post is now the hardest door in the Citadel. Astro: "Harden your own house first, Volt. You just did."

files.C:\\Citadel\\README.txt:
ORDERS FROM ASTRO
=================
Vex is targeting Volt's own guard post, the weakest machine in the Citadel. Harden it:
1. Disable the Guest account.
2. Give Volt a real, strong password.
3. Stop the unused relay-legacy service still running.
4. Volt's Drill: try to log in as Guest afterward. It should fail.

steps.title: Harden the post
steps.body: Volt: "My own post, the weakest machine. Fix that." Disable Guest (`net user guest /active:no`), give volt a strong password (`net user volt <new-password>`), and stop the old relay-legacy service (`taskkill /im relaylegacy.exe /f`).

steps.title: Volt's Drill: re-scan
steps.body: Volt: "Run it again. Prove the wall holds." Try `login guest anything` now that it's disabled. It should fail.
